versions.name: RXV2-0.9.556-telemetry-guard
versions.notes: Fix + safeguard: after a bank copy the transmitter showed no volts and no RPM - the flight controller's telemetry sensor list and link rate had been wiped (all zero; cause still unknown - the receiver did not write them). Rotorflight only sends the sensors on that list, so an empty list makes a healthy FC mute. The receiver now reads that list after it finds the FC, and if it is empty the Home and Rotorflight pages show a red notice with a one-tap 'Restore telemetry sensors' button (transmitter off - the FC restarts). Copy a bank: the result now pops up so it cannot be missed, and the 'from' caption leads with the bank you picked instead of the bank the FC is on. Pages changed - apps 4.11 / 4.03 carry the same.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.555-copybank-route
versions.notes: Fix: the Copy-a-bank page (Rotorflight > Copy a bank) opened fine in the app but gave 'not found' in a web browser on the receiver's own pages - the firmware was missing the link for it. Firmware only - pages unchanged.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.554-fs-wipe-on-fail
versions.notes: Safer updates: if the web-files (pages) download dies part-way (weak WiFi, power lost), the receiver now wipes the half-written pages instead of booting on them - a half-written page store hung the Goblin's receiver until a power cycle (2026-09-03). A wiped receiver still works fully from the app; run the update again to put its pages back. Backups and flights are carried across as before. Firmware only - pages unchanged.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.553-copy-bank
versions.notes: New 'Copy a bank' page (Rotorflight hub 4th door + A la carte): PIDs, PID+, rescue, rates and governor gains from one bank to another in ONE tap, saved, read back and verified byte for byte; each bank keeps its own head speed unless you tick 'Head speed too'; refused while armed; flight controller returned to the bank it was on. (Per-page 'Copy to Profile (Bank)' at the bottom of the PIDs / PID+ / Rates / Governor pages is unchanged.) Pages only - firmware behaviour unchanged.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.552-quiet-landing
versions.notes: Quieter event log: no false 'FC lost' after every flight (the FC probe pauses in the air; it now gets a fresh 10 s after landing) and one 'Swap unbilled' breadcrumb per 5 s instead of seven after every TX-off. Firmware only - pages unchanged.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.551-throttle-parked
versions.notes: Governor pages now warn when the transmitter throttle sat below 100 % while armed (the head runs stable but slow and bank changes do nothing) - the receiver learns the throttle channel and governor mode from Rotorflight itself. New 'Governor controls the spool-up (PID spool-up)' switch in the governor profile. No more swash twitches: the event log is saved append-only and never while armed. Loop stalls now name the call that caused them.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.550-field-landing-ble
versions.notes: Field landing fix: after a flight the receiver used to switch Bluetooth back on AND start a 100-second hunt for your home WiFi - which it cannot find at the field. That hunt swamped the phone's Bluetooth link, so the app connected but pages never loaded until a reboot (Goblin, 3 Sep). Now a receiver that never joined home WiFi this power-up revives Bluetooth only after landing; WiFi comes back only where home WiFi was actually joined. Also stops the 'disarmed - radios back on' log entry repeating every 5 seconds at the field, and logs a 'BLE reply stalled' event when Bluetooth replies are being refused, so this kind of fault shows up in the receiver's event log.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.549-blackbox-setup
versions.notes: New wizard step 13, Flight recorder: sets up Rotorflight's own onboard black box in plain English - when to record (whenever armed, no switch needed; or by the Blackbox switch, with a warning if no switch is assigned), where (flight-controller memory, SD card, serial), how often (as samples per second worked out from the control-loop rate), seconds to keep recording after disarm, overwrite-oldest-when-full, and which fields (Recommended set = Rotorflight's defaults + ESC + Governor, so head-speed problems show up). Shows the memory used and erases it with one red-confirmed tap, watching until the flight controller reports empty. Every save is read back and compared, so a flight controller that is busy recording (it silently ignores edits then) is reported honestly; rate or device changes offer the restart they need. Refused while armed. Also in A la carte. Firmware: route only.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.548-rotor-motor-labels
versions.notes: Gear-ratio boxes are now labelled rotor : motor (and rotor : tail) so which way round is obvious at a glance (Malcolm's suggestion after the Goblin's backwards entry); the pinion/main-gear sub-labels and most of the explanatory text are gone - one line: rotor : motor, how many turns each makes, e.g. 1 : 10.2, or the teeth counts. Decimals are accepted and stored as the whole-number pair Rotorflight keeps (1 : 10.2 -> 10 : 102). Same on ESC-setup step 7 and First-time basics; shorter Backwards readouts. No firmware behaviour change.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.547-two-stage-gear-help
versions.notes: Gear-ratio help for two-stage drives (belt to a big pulley, then pinion into the main gear - every SAB Goblin, RAW and Black Thunder): multiply the stages. Main = motor pulley x drive pinion : big pulley x main gear (Goblin 770 = 21x19 : 60x68 = 399 : 4080). Tail = tail pulley x drive pinion : front tail pulley x main gear (Goblin 770 = 25x19 : 37x68 = 475 : 2516). Shown on the Gear-ratio page, ESC-setup step 7 and the First-time basics hints. No firmware behaviour change.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.546-gear-ratio-on-the-fc
versions.notes: Gear ratio now lives on the flight controller: the Gear-ratio page and ESC-setup step 7 edit Rotorflight's own main/tail ratio (pinion : main gear, with a plain-English readout that turns red when it is backwards), save + read back, offer the restart Rotorflight needs, and reset the receiver's old divisor to 1. First-time basics gets the same readout and a warning before saving a backwards ratio. Found on the Goblin: 10 : 1 entered backwards made the governor sit at minimum throttle (every bank the same speed).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.545-release-in-view
versions.notes: ESC settings: the Release ESC button now floats next to Save (always in view) and pulses when it is the next step; a forgotten session shows a red do-not-fly warning; every verdict says to finish with Release ESC before you fly.
